mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys_user ( school_id, role_id, username, password_hash, display_name, mobile, enabled ) VALUES ( #{schoolId}, (SELECT id FROM sys_role WHERE role_code = #{roleCode}), #{username}, #{passwordHash}, #{displayName}, #{mobile}, #{enabled} )
mapper.sql: t.id, t.school_id AS schoolId, s.school_name AS schoolName, t.user_id AS userId, u.username, t.teacher_no AS teacherNo, t.full_name AS fullName, t.phone, t.title, t.status, u.last_login_at AS lastLoginAt
mapper.select: SELECT FROM teacher t JOIN school s ON s.id = t.school_id JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = t.user_id WHERE t.school_id = #{schoolId} ORDER BY t.full_name, t.id
mapper.sql: st.id, st.school_id AS schoolId, st.user_id AS userId, u.username, s.school_name AS schoolName, st.class_id AS classId, c.class_name AS className, c.grade, c.school_year AS schoolYear, st.student_no AS studentNo, st.full_name AS fullName, st.gender, st.date_of_birth AS dateOfBirth, st.status
mapper.select: SELECT FROM student st JOIN school s ON s.id = st.school_id JOIN school_class c ON c.id = st.class_id LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = st.user_id WHERE st.school_id = #{schoolId} ORDER BY c.grade, c.class_name, st.student_no

SELECT FROM student st JOIN school s ON s.id = st.school_id JOIN school_class c ON c.id = st.class_id LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = st.user_id WHERE st.school_id = #{schoolId} AND st.student_no = #{studentNo}
mapper.sql: g.id, u.school_id AS schoolId, s.school_name AS schoolName, g.user_id AS userId, u.username, g.full_name AS fullName, g.mobile, g.status, GROUP_CONCAT(st.full_name ORDER BY st.full_name SEPARATOR '、') AS childNames, GROUP_CONCAT(st.id ORDER BY st.id) AS studentIds, MIN(sg.relationship) AS relationship, MAX(sg.is_primary) AS `primary`
mapper.select: SELECT FROM guardian g JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = g.user_id JOIN school s ON s.id = u.school_id LEFT JOIN student_guardian sg ON sg.guardian_id = g.id AND sg.is_active = TRUE LEFT JOIN student st ON st.id = sg.student_id WHERE u.school_id = #{schoolId} GROUP BY g.id, u.school_id, s.school_name, g.user_id, u.username, g.full_name, g.mobile, g.status ORDER BY g.full_name, g.id

SELECT FROM guardian g JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = g.user_id JOIN school s ON s.id = u.school_id LEFT JOIN student_guardian sg ON sg.guardian_id = g.id AND sg.is_active = TRUE LEFT JOIN student st ON st.id = sg.student_id WHERE u.school_id = #{schoolId} AND u.username = #{username} GROUP BY g.id, u.school_id, s.school_name, g.user_id, u.username, g.full_name, g.mobile, g.status
